column3: NKJV includes “the scribes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the chief priests and the elders.” “Courtyard” is rendered “palace.”
Close to the Greek; “beautiful work” is rendered “good work.”
Close to the Greek; “appointed” is rendered “counted out.”
